topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: The morning air was a bit too cool as I walked to the fence, where the neighbor stood, a hesitant smile playing at the edges of his lips. He asked about a part of the yard, a patch of land that hasn’t felt quite mine in a long while. The grass there is quieter, the sun a little dimmer, as if even nature prefers the other side. I nodded, my voice a whisper, telling him it was fine, even though the thought of those hands turning the earth made me feel a little more adrift in my own space. But the yard, it could use some life, couldn’t it? I told him yes, and watched as he nodded, a small lift in his eyes, while I turned back to the house, the quiet inside welcome.
